clauses.reason: The lead states that the order is issued in view of Russia's continued use of its military-industrial base and reliance on the international financial system, to take additional steps with respect to the national emergency declared in Executive Order 14024, expanded by Executive Order 14066 and relied on in Executive Orders 14039, 14068 and 14071. The amendments took effect on signing, December 22, 2023, and the amended text of Executive Order 14024 continues in force with its parent. No held instrument revokes, supersedes, amends or limits this clause. The national emergency declared in Executive Order 14024 was continued after the order's issue by the Federal Register notices of April 9, 2024, April 10, 2025 and March 24, 2026; the last, dated March 24, 2026 (91 FR 15515), continues it beyond April 15, 2026 for 1 year, which covers 2026-10-14. The clause was therefore operative on 2026-10-14.

The amendments took effect on signing, December 22, 2023, and the amended text of Executive Order 14024 continues in force with its parent. The inventory in the packet held one clause, so the inventory is corrected from the held Federal Register text (11 clauses).
